title: Polar coordinates for integrable functions on ℝ^{m+1} (formula (P) of Step 1)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let S := {θ ∈ ℝⁿ : |θ| = 1} be the unit sphere of ℝⁿ = Eucl n, and let σ := (Lⁿ).toSphere be the measure on S induced by Lebesgue measure Lⁿ = volume (Mathlib's Measure.toSphere; σ(A) = n·Lⁿ({rθ : 0 < r < 1, θ ∈ A}) for measurable A ⊆ S, by Measure.toSphere_apply'). Then for every Lebesgue-integrable g : ℝⁿ → ℝ, ∫_{ℝⁿ} g(x) dx = ∫_S (∫_{(0,∞)} r^m·g(rθ) dr) dσ(θ).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), Integrable g → ∫ x, g x = ∫ θ : sphere (0 : Eucl (m + 1)) 1, (∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), r ^ m * g (r • (θ : Eucl (m + 1)))) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))).toSphere
